_comment: THE defaults for build_coop_train_val_dataset.py and build_inference.py -- the scripts hardcode none of these. Edit this file and run a script with NO flags. A CLI flag is optional and overrides the matching key for that one run only; no script ever writes this file. Relative paths are resolved against the qcar_testbed_integration/ root.

marker_offsets._comment: Vicon reports the origin of each car's Vicon object (the centre of its 5 markers), not the vehicle centre. Body-frame (forward, lateral) metres from that origin to the centre of the car's exterior box, per OFFSET NAME. Agents pick theirs through vehicles.<id>.marker_offset; static/dynamic targets through their 'vehicle' field. An entry is either measured directly (fwd_m/lat_m) or by a 180-degree reversal test relative to an already-resolved entry: centre = midpoint of readings A and B taken inside the same taped wheel marks; offset = reference offset + reversal(vehicle) - reversal(reference). Readings are [x_m, y_m, yaw_rad]. lidar_fwd_m/lidar_lat_m (marker -> LiDAR point) are recorded for reference only; no script reads them.

car1_ego.source: Carro 1 / ego (192.168.0.73 = qcar-52775), measured in the lab 2026-10-09 per vault note '2026-10-09 0000 - REFERENCIA — QCar Vicon measured offsets 2026-10-09' (marker -> LiDAR measured, + 2.35 cm LiDAR -> exterior-box centre). Agrees with the 2026-09-14 measurement (0.0343, -0.0209) to 0.4 / 1.5 mm.

car2_coop.source: Carro 2 / cooperador (192.168.0.89), same note and method as car1_ego. Before this measurement the cooperator reused the ego's offset.

car3_third.source: Carro 3 / third (conventional, the car at Node9), same note and method as car1_ego. Agrees with the 2026-10-06 reversal test ('third_reversal_20261006') to 3.5 / 1.3 mm.

qcar.source: measured on qcar-52775 2026-09-14; independently recovered (0.0334, -0.0178) by a 19-point image/Vicon least-squares fit. Still used for the two PARKED QCars of ExperimentNo1 (static_targets), whose own offsets were never measured.

third_reversal_20261006.source: 180-degree reversal test 2026-10-06, reference = QCar 192.168.0.73 (qcar-52775) measured the same way; forward component and yaw agree with a bicycle-model fit on driving data. Superseded by car3_third; kept as the history of the datasets built 2026-10-06.

vehicles._comment: Physical identity of each agent id (was CAR_REGISTRY in build_coop_train_val_dataset.py / build_inference.py). The same physical car keeps its id across sessions even when its IP changes; a session's agent_dirs says which folder holds it. calib_name -> calib_root/<calib_name>/latest_front/<calib_name>_front_intrinsics_verified.npz. marker_offset -> marker_offsets.<name>. camera_extrinsic -> camera_extrinsics.<name>; qcar/patches/patch_real_extrinsic.py reads the same entry, so dataset building and training cannot disagree.

2._note: ASSUMED: .1.158 and .0.89 are the same physical car (the builder has always used qcar52776's intrinsics for .0.89). Unconfirmed as of 2026-10-14.

camera_extrinsics._comment: Front camera -> vehicle body: R_cb (3x3, rows) and t_cb_m (metres, body frame). cam_cords_mount names the entry whose t_cb_m places camera0's cords in every agent yaml (rotation is applied later by patch_real_extrinsic.py).

manual_nominal.source: Quanser QCar user_manual_system_hardware.pdf p.9 (Quanser_Qcar_Calibration), matrix csi_front_to_body. Computed det(R_cb) = +1, although the manual's text says -1.

qcar52775_refined.source: qcar-52775 front camera, refined 2026-09-14 from 19 image/Vicon click correspondences (0.46-2.9 m, full yaw range), median reprojection error 7.7 px.

sessions._comment: 2026-09-13/14, 9 trajectories, two parked QCars as static_targets. root=null means onboard_root; val=null means val_indices.
sessions.name: ExperimentNo1
